🎁 Try it: enter a basket raffle

  1. Pick a basket below and look at what's inside — every item was donated, so the club paid almost nothing for it.
  2. Type any name and choose how many $5 tickets to "buy" (this demo won't charge anyone).
  3. Watch the ticket count on the basket and the charity tally above both go up instantly.
  4. When you're done playing, scroll down and press Run the drawing to see how winners are picked.

💰 Why this raises real money

  • Baskets are built from donated goods, so ticket sales are nearly 100% proceeds.
  • A basket worth $300 often sells far more than $300 in $5 tickets — people buy chances, not the item.
  • The 50/50 needs no donations at all: the winner takes half the pot, charity keeps the other half.
  • QR codes on each physical basket let guests enter from their phones in seconds — no paper tickets to sell, tear, and count.

Sample Event: "Tampa Bay Treasures" Basket Raffle Five demo baskets · $5 per ticket · draws at the event

🏆 Run the drawing

At the real event, an officer presses one button per basket and the app picks a winning ticket at random — the more tickets someone bought, the better their odds, exactly like pulling a stub from a bowl. Try it here with the demo entries (including any tickets you just added):

🧭 What the real app adds

  • raffle.html — the live public page. Same look as this demo, but entries are saved to the club's database (Supabase) so every phone sees the same counts.
  • QR sheet — officers print one QR code per basket (raffle-qr-sheet.html); guests scan and land right on that basket.
  • Members Hub → Raffles — where officers create events, add baskets and photos, confirm payments, and record winners.
  • Payments — tickets are recorded digitally, then settled in person (cash or card) with a volunteer before the draw.

📋 Running one at your event

  1. Ask members and local shops for themed donations (the five baskets here are realistic examples).
  2. Photograph each finished basket and add it in the Members Hub with a value and contents list.
  3. Print and tape the QR cards to the baskets on event day.
  4. Guests enter all evening from their phones; the tally page shows progress toward the goal.
  5. Draw winners in person, record them in the app, and the public page shows 🏆 next to each basket.
